title: INSPECTION PROCEDURE
ocr_text:
BR–135

BRAKE SYSTEM – TRACTION CONTROL SYSTEM (TRAC)

INSPECTION PROCEDURE

1   Check TRAC fuse.

R/B No.2

TRAC

R07408

P   Remove TRAC fuse from R/B No.2.

C   Check continuity of TRAC fuse.

OK   Continuity

OK

NG   Check for short in all harness and components connected to TRAC fuse.

2   Check voltage between terminals BM and GND of TRAC ECU.

LOCK

BM

GND

BE6653
R07198

P   Remove TRAC ECU with connectors still connected.

C   Measure voltage between terminals BM and GND of TRAC ECU.

OK   Voltage: 10 – 14 V

OK

NG   Check and repair harness or connector.
